name: Adnan Ahmad
title: Software Engineer
about: Software engineer building the core of creator-economy platforms at Vues: APIs and data, video rendering, and the cloud under them. Delhi, India.

items.content:
Building the core of creator-economy platforms at Vues: APIs and data, video rendering, and the cloud infrastructure under them. I've been writing open-source tools since 2019, usually to solve problems I kept running into.

I like reverse engineering apps and APIs to see how they work, and how they break.

items.title: DebridUI
items.subtitle: Modern debrid client with integrated media discovery
items.description: A fast debrid client that connects to debrid service APIs, enabling users to manage files across multiple accounts, track downloads in real-time, and browse media catalogs with Trakt.tv integration.

items.title: tiiny
items.subtitle: Self-hosted link shortener that counts clicks, not people
items.description: A Rust link shortener with custom slugs, privacy-friendly daily stats (no IPs or per-visit records), link previews, guest links, OAuth sign-in and an admin abuse queue. Ships as one Docker container using about 9 MB of memory at idle, backed by libSQL or Turso.

items.title: rspace
items.subtitle: Native desktop app to manage and sync 70+ cloud storages
items.description: A Rust desktop app built on rclone that puts Drive, S3, Dropbox, OneDrive, B2, SFTP and 70+ other backends in one window. Background transfers with live progress and ETA, built-in file previews, recursive search, and a keyboard-driven command palette. Ships for macOS, Windows and Linux.

items.title: supabase-orm
items.subtitle: Async, Pydantic-native Python ORM for Supabase — runs in production at Vues
items.description: Pydantic models double as tables with a typed, autocompleting query builder, declarative embeds, keyset iteration and typed RPC. Async-first for FastAPI with a generated sync mirror and per-request RLS. Powers the data layer of the Vues API and background jobs.

items.title: StreamDash
items.subtitle: Video streaming platform-as-a-service with global CDN
items.description: Upload once, stream everywhere. A video hosting platform with automatic HLS conversion, global CDN delivery, multiple audio tracks, subtitles support, and embeddable player. Features unlimited bandwidth and no expiration on stored content.

items.title: Google Drive Telegram Bot
items.subtitle: Manage Google Drive through Telegram — 700+ stars 1.5k+ forks
items.description: A Telegram bot to upload files from Telegram or direct links to Google Drive. Supports cloning, deleting files, TeamDrive operations, and youtube-dl integration.

items.title: Telegram Message Forwarder Bot
items.subtitle: Auto-forward messages between Telegram chats — 440+ stars 460+ forks
items.description: A Telegram bot that forwards messages from channels, groups or chats to other chats as they arrive, with multi-source routing and text replacement rules, configured through a single TOML file.

items.title: Lemonic
items.subtitle: A calm, elegant music streaming app — scalable to millions of users
items.description: A drop-in replacement for Spotify with a beautiful, soothing player UI. Uses Spotify's Web API for metadata and Lemonic API for streaming. Fully compatible with Spotify's path patterns for seamless transition.

items.title: transferit-py
items.subtitle: Python client and CLI for transfer.it file sharing
items.description: Upload and download files on transfer.it without a browser or MEGA account. End-to-end encrypted with the same scheme as the official client, concurrent WebSocket uploads, constant-memory streaming downloads, and folder support, as both a library and a CLI.

items.title: DBStash
items.subtitle: Dockerized database backup via rclone to any cloud storage
items.description: Stream database dumps directly to any cloud storage backend without intermediate files or local disk pressure. Supports multiple database engines with rclone-powered cloud delivery.

items.title: iHospital
items.subtitle: Production-ready iOS native hospital management system
items.description: A comprehensive hospital management system with patient and admin apps. Features appointment scheduling, patient records, lab test tracking, billing, and canvas-based prescription writing with PDF export. Built with full accessibility support including VoiceOver and Dynamic Type.

items.title: GateKeep
items.subtitle: Open-source end-to-end encrypted 2FA authenticator app
items.description: Open-source end-to-end encrypted 2FA framework using client-side AES-256-CBC encryption, PBKDF2 key derivation, and HMAC-SHA256 integrity checks.

items.title: Font Library
items.subtitle: Static font listing website with interactive previews
items.description: Interactive font showcase with editable previews. Auto-extracts font metadata using fontkit. Browse font families with pagination and theme support.

items.title: SwitchBot
items.subtitle: IoT relay controller with ESP32 and WebSocket
items.description: A home automation system that turns electrical appliances into smart devices. Control up to 8 relays remotely via REST API or WebSocket, with manual switch override and WiFi captive portal setup.
